subject: Re: imGHUM status: decision - flag-and-ship, go for scan cleanup v1
body:
All,

Decision for the June 29 memo: it's a GO for scan-cleanup v1, flag-and-ship on hands. The 83% vs 61% completion result carries the case on its own, and Efe's framing is right - a flagged low-confidence hand region keeps a human in the loop exactly where the model is guessing. Silent completion would have been the version that erodes trust.

Scope notes for the memo: hand-specific fitting is the first v1.1 item, and the surface-semantics labeling goes in as an explicit bonus deliverable since the cleanup tooling team is already building against it. External-facing anything remains gated on the licensing-note review plus Launch Review Board - internal pipeline use only until both clear.

Gustavo - thanks for the early v2 migration; handing off eval manifests that are already freeze-proof is the quiet kind of competence I appreciate.

Lucia
